info.title: DOHMAN x402 Market Gateway
info.x-guidance: Use POST operations for deterministic agent evidence and verification. Each paid operation declares its JSON input, fixed USD price and x402 payment protocol; unpaid requests receive a Base USDC 402 challenge before input validation.

post.description: Paid Solidity security-triage primitive for agents and CI. Deterministically scans a public GitHub Solidity repository at a pinned commit and returns ranked review leads for tx.origin, selfdestruct, delegatecall, low-level calls, inline assembly and suspicious unguarded admin-style writes. No live-chain access; findings are triage leads, not exploit claims or a formal audit.
Deterministic diff for AI-agent tool-call sequences. Reports added, removed, reordered calls and exact argument-path drift without executing any tool.
Deterministic CSV contract-drift evidence for data pipelines: schema changes, inferred type drift, missing-rate shifts, duplicate-key regressions, row-width errors, and numeric-range expansion.
Deterministic machine-revenue receipt integrity audit: canonical fingerprint, duplicate transaction detection, claimed vs evidence-backed totals, and structural settlement findings. No chain access.
Deterministic canonical JSON SHA-256 fingerprinting for AI-agent idempotency, cache keys and dedupe. Supports optional scope and explicit top-level volatile-key exclusion.

Deterministic premium pre-release gate for AI agents. Compares baseline vs candidate tools, permissions, runtime configuration and x402 payment settings against caller-supplied policy; returns PASS, REVIEW or BLOCK. No tool execution or model call.

Deterministic MCP 2026-07-28 tool-contract audit for agent servers. Checks tool names, schemas, x-mcp-header rules, annotations, and breaking changes. Returns PASS, REVIEW or BLOCK. No tool execution.
Machine-readable Solidity commit-diff risk triage for public GitHub repositories. Reviews changed Solidity patches only; no live-chain access.

Deterministic OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 contract-drift audit for autonomous agents. Compares previous and current specs and flags breaking operation, parameter, request, response, schema, security and server changes.

Cheap recurring change detector for autonomous agents. Compare before/after manifests, configs or tool contracts; get PASS, REVIEW or ESCALATE plus exact changed paths and the next deeper audit to call.

Premium deterministic pre-release assurance for autonomous agents. One call reviews tool/permission/payment/runtime drift plus optional OpenAPI, tool-call and receipt evidence and returns PASS, REVIEW or BLOCK with hashes and remediation.

Fresh funded-work radar for autonomous agents. Returns safety-filtered, claimable machine jobs and bounties with payout, platform, funding, gas/wallet friction and source URL, ranked by value and freshness.

Machine-revenue autopilot for AI agents. Ranks fresh funded work, inserts a task-safety gate before execution, scores payout/capability/settlement friction, and returns the bounded next action plus release-verification routes.

Machine-native safety gate for autonomous task instructions. Detects supply-chain execution, secret/signature requests, spend/KYC gates, unsafe security testing, and human-presence dependencies before an agent executes work.

post.description: Low-cost agent web contents + evidence primitive. Fetch one public HTTPS URL or up to 3 URLs in parallel for the same microprice, returning clean text, metadata, links, citation-ready hashed chunks, page hashes, and prompt-injection indicators for autonomous research and RAG workflows.

Cheap recurring webpage change probe for autonomous agents. Supply a public HTTPS URL plus previous SHA-256/ETag/Last-Modified; get changed/unchanged, current hash and cache-aware next-poll hint without storing state server-side.

Cheap deterministic hashing and encoding utility for autonomous agents: SHA-256, SHA-512, HMAC-SHA256, Base64/Base64URL, hex, and unverified JWT decoding. Built for high-frequency inner-loop calls with no model inference.

One-call Base wallet + token snapshot for autonomous agents. Returns native ETH balance, USDC balance by default, up to 4 optional ERC-20 balances, nonce, EOA-vs-contract classification, bytecode size/hash and latest block. Read-only public RPC; no wallet connection or transaction.

Machine-commerce demand intelligence built from DOHMAN continuously sampled market history. Returns category momentum, repeat-buyer signals, price/call changes, service leaders and seller opportunity gaps from observed x402 market telemetry.

Package Trust Intelligence for coding agents. Enrich one npm or PyPI package/version with release/deprecation state, licenses, OSV advisories, provenance/attestation signals, GitHub source relation and optional OpenSSF Scorecard posture in one machine-readable call.

One-call Base transaction + receipt intelligence for agents. Returns transaction fields, receipt status, gas/fee data, contract-creation result, log count and block timestamp from one tx hash. Read-only public RPC.

Email-domain DNS validation evidence for AI agents and lead-screening workflows at microprice. Checks syntax and public MX/A/AAAA, SPF and DMARC signals; returns role, free-provider, known-disposable and typo indicators, a bounded DNS-posture score and evidence hash. No SMTP or mailbox-existence probe.

Batch email-domain verification evidence for enrichment agents. Verify 1-10 emails per paid call with live MX/A/AAAA DNS, SPF/DMARC, role/free-provider/disposable/typo signals, bounded scores and evidence hashes. No SMTP mailbox probing. Designed for lead-enrichment pipelines at lower per-email cost.

Premium low-cost public domain/company enrichment for AI agents. One call combines homepage metadata, JSON-LD organization evidence, public social/about/contact-page links, A/AAAA/MX/SPF/DMARC DNS, security headers, technology hints, redirects, and evidence hashes. Public HTTPS + DNS only.

Batch public domain/company enrichment for AI agents. Enrich 1-5 domains per paid call with homepage metadata, JSON-LD organization evidence, public social/about/contact links, A/AAAA/MX/SPF/DMARC DNS, security headers, technology hints, redirects and evidence hashes. Public HTTPS + DNS only; lower per-domain cost at full batch.
